Bucket composite, laid over GDP and CPI

Every series is read against a year earlier, turned into a z-score against its own long history, averaged inside a bucket, and the buckets are combined with weights that stand for importance for GDP or for the CPI basket. The official print sets the scale of the percent reading and nothing else. Everything is as it was known on the day.

        The Pulse is part of The Quant Barometer, a research project: statistical estimates that are frequently wrong. Nothing here is investment advice or a recommendation to trade. Built 2026-11-12 from statistics published by national statistics offices, central banks, ministries, Eurostat, the ECB, the OECD and industry bodies, with thanks to each. It also reads survey and industry series that remain the property of their publishers, among them ISM, The Conference Board, ADP, NFIB, Cass, Challenger, Dodge, CFIB, Ivey, NAB, Westpac and the Melbourne Institute, Roy Morgan, GfK and NIM, HDE and SMMT: they are shown for research, without any commercial use, credited to their publishers, and a publisher's series will be removed at its request (through the site's repository). Market prices, forecasts and other institutions' nowcasts are never inputs.
